fact: A taskbook may list facts directly in its Facts section.
Within a taskbook, /fact(n) refers to the authored fact numbered n in that taskbook.
The taskbook digest covers the Markdown and optional fact attachment; without a Taskbook ID the plugin derives the ID from this digest.
The Facts header may specify a separate attachment. Its path must be relative and resolve within the taskbook directory.
Goal and Delivery items receive G and D identifiers. Inline facts use F. Attachment items use AF when inline facts exist, or F when the attachment supplies all facts.
